title: Fixed-power bound for the family size
statement: Let $n,C,Q$ be nonnegative integers, let $t>0$, and let $0<\varepsilon\leq1/2$. Suppose $n\geq1$, $1/(Q+1)\leq\varepsilon$, and $t\leq(C+1)(\sqrt{\lceil\log_2(n+1)\rceil}+1)$. Put $a=8(C+1)(Q+1)+1$, $b=128(Q+1)^2(C+1)^3+4a+5$, $e=2a(b+1)$, $d=\lceil8t/\varepsilon\rceil$, $\theta=(\varepsilon/8)^2t^{-2}(1/9)^d$, and $k=\lceil2t/\theta\rceil$. Then $(d+1)(k+1)^d\leq2^{2e}(n+1)^e$.
